sheets.prompt: Surface design sheet for a science fiction exploration game, the walls of a city built under the sea and sealed under great glass domes: smooth rounded walls and domes of pale coral pink and shell-cream render, softly weathered by damp sea air, faint white salt bloom gathered along the base and under ledges, a few horizontal tide lines of a slightly darker tone where water once stood, sparse tiny barnacle-like dots and pale green growth stains in the shaded corners only, round porthole windows with brass rims, repaired patches of a fresher pink. Three panels side by side: a large square-on swatch of the wall; a curved street of these domed houses seen from a walker's height with a small figure for scale, blue-green light falling through the glass above; a strip showing the marks simplifying with distance, tide lines and patches staying, dots and salt gone far. Calm and readable, flat colour dominant, marks sparse and fine. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, coral pink, shell cream, sea green and a touch of brass, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, photo texture, text, watermark, lettering, labels, fish, seaweed.
